Class AssignRouteController

java.lang.Object
controller.AssignRouteController
public class AssignRouteController extends Object
Controller class responsible for managing route assignments for trains. Handles the creation and management of routes between stations.

    • checkValidation

      public boolean checkValidation()
      Validates if there are enough stations and trains available for route assignment. A valid configuration requires at least 2 stations and at least 1 train.
      Returns:
      true if there are enough stations and trains for route assignment, false otherwise

    • assignRoute

      public void assignRoute(Train train, List<PointOfRoute> pointOfRoutes)
      Assigns a specified route to a train and prints the details of the assigned route, including cargo availability and demand at each station.
      Parameters:
      train - the train to which the route will be assigned
      pointOfRoutes - the list of points of route that define the route for the train

      train - the train to which the route will be assigned
      stations - the list of stations that define the route for the train

    • displayStations

      public void displayStations(Train train, List<Station> stations)
      Displays information about the stations in a train's route. Prints details including station name, position, cargo availability, and demand.
      Parameters:
      train - The train whose route stations are being displayed
      stations - The list of stations in the train's route

    • setCargoMode

      public void setCargoMode(Train train, int pointIndex, CargoMode mode)
      Sets the cargo mode for a specific point in the train's route and provides a visual sign of the configuration and behavior based on the mode. If the specified point index corresponds to a valid station in the train's route, additional details about the cargo mode configuration at the station are displayed.
      Parameters:
      train - the train whose cargo mode is being configured
      pointIndex - the index of the point in the train's route where the cargo mode is to be set
      mode - the cargo mode to be set, determining the departure conditions from the station
